The shop

A suite in the plaza on 9th Street East

Doggone Salon is one unit in North Tapps Place — a small room, a table, and a few groomers who have been doing this a long time.

Doggone Salon LLC has been accredited by the Better Business Bureau with an A+ rating since December 2019.

Three of the groomers get called out by name in the reviews people leave. You'll see them below.
